picks.matchup: Buffalo Bills vs New York Jets
picks.analysis: The Buffalo Bills are set to face the New York Jets. With Buffalo favored by 7.5 points, and given the Jets' lower H2H odds and spread, the Bills' experienced coaching under Joe Brady gives them an edge over the developing Jets team coached by Aaron Glenn. This contest also garners high media attention, increasing the buzz around the matchup.

picks.matchup: Washington Commanders vs New York Giants
picks.analysis: The Giants, behind newly announced QB J.J. McCarthy, look to leverage their slight favorite status over the Commanders. Using John Harbaugh's strategic edge, the Giants should efficiently counter Washington's tactics, coached by Dan Quinn.

key_news: Harbaugh: Giants 'feel fairly good' about McCarthy (hip) playing vs. Commanders

picks.matchup: Arizona Cardinals vs Los Angeles Rams
picks.analysis: Head coach Sean McVay leads the Rams as favorites at home against the Cardinals. With a spread of -7, the Rams look to assert dominance over Mike LaFleur's Cardinals, who have shown inconsistency in recent games.

picks.matchup: Las Vegas Raiders vs Seattle Seahawks
picks.analysis: The Seahawks, starting backup QB Drew Lock against the Raiders, hold a slight edge under Mike Macdonald's scheme. Seattle's decision to rest regular starter Sam Darnold gives this game a unique intrigue.

key_news: Seahawks to start QB Drew Lock vs. Raiders, giving Sam Darnold more time to heal
